summary: Iteration 1 of multi-iteration build (team assignment + operational dashboard). Backend smoke testing passed for nearly all new endpoints (auth, admin users w/ team/department, assignment rules list/CRUD/apply, ownership mappings, operational dashboard with team filter, RBAC 403 for non-admin). Frontend testing is BLOCKED by a SyntaxError in /app/frontend/src/components/Sidebar.jsx (duplicated trailing JSX fragment after the component already closed at line 87 — the file ends with an extra `>`, ``, ``, ``, ``, `);`, `}` on lines 88-96). The webpack dev-server overlay 'Compiled with problems' is rendered instead of the app on every route, so login UI, sidebar nav, /operational, /admin/assignment-rules, /admin/ownership, and /findings could not be exercised.
passed: POST /api/auth/login — admin & analyst tokens issued (returns 'token' field)
GET /api/v1/admin/users — returns {items:[...]} with team='Platform Eng' for analyst and team='Payments Squad' for manager; department populated
PATCH /api/v1/admin/users/{id} as admin -> 200 {ok:true}; as analyst -> 403 'Insufficient role'

GET /api/v1/admin/assignment-rules — 5 seeded rules returned in priority order: Internet-facing→NetSec(10), Crown jewel→DBA Team(20), Windows→IT Ops(30), Code→Platform Eng(40), Production Linux→Platform Eng(50)
GET /api/v1/ownership-mappings — 12 assets returned with hostname, owner_team, ownership_confidence (e.g. 0.95), environment etc.

GET /api/v1/dashboards/operational — keys present: total_open=77, aging_buckets {0-7:5,8-30:8,31-60:12,61-90:14,90+:38}, mttr_days=11.4, reopen_rate=14.3, scan_coverage_pct=83.3, reopened_open=3, active_exceptions=0, throughput length=30, by_assignee length=5, overdue_by_severity present, team_scope='All teams'

failed.evidence: Screenshot from /login shows webpack overlay 'ERROR in ./src/components/Sidebar.jsx — Module build failed ... Unexpected token (88:8)'. view_file lines 75-96 confirm duplicated tail after the function already closed with '}'.

failed.issue: PATCH /api/v1/admin/assignment-rules/{id} requires FULL body (name, field, value, assign_team all required) — partial patches like {priority:101} return 422. Not a true PATCH semantically. Acceptable for iteration 1 but worth tightening.
failed.evidence: PATCH with {priority:101} -> 422 listing 4 'missing' fields; same id with full body -> 200 {ok:true}.

action_items: Fix /app/frontend/src/components/Sidebar.jsx — delete the duplicated dangling JSX fragment after line 87 (the file should end at the first closing '}' of the Sidebar component). Without this fix no frontend feature can be verified.
(Optional) Make assignment-rule PATCH fields Optional[...] so callers can update a single attribute (e.g., priority/active) without re-sending the whole rule.
test_credentials: Present at /app/memory/test_credentials.md — admin/analyst/manager logins all succeed against /api/auth/login.
